text:
li: FYI nightly for cerulean-v1 int8 shows localized quality drops on ja->en and zh->en. suspect invisible-char handling (ZWJ, NBSP) in detok/tokenizer artifact.

anika: paste an example and the sacrebleu?

li: minimal failing sample:
```
# source (ja):
タブを具合する・・・リョクカ‍アマ。
# fp16 -> en:
I will prepare the tab... Ryokuka Ama.
# int8 -> en:
I will prepare the tab... RyokukaAma.
# sacrebleu: fp16 31.2, int8 26.7 (-4.5)
```

mike: tokenizer diff shows ZWJ present in baseline tokens but missing in int8 build (merged name tokens).

yuki: we rebuilt tokenizer artifact in the int8 pipeline with a micro-merge optimization. likely culprit. also a detok rule collapsed NBSP+ZWJ combos in a recent PR.

infra-bot: queued rerun (pin-tokenizer-artifact). run id: 2026-03-23-cerulean-5111112222. logs: https://internal.redwood/evals/5111112222

anika: triage steps: 1) pin fp16 tokenizer into int8 job and rerun subset 2) rerun detok with NBSP/ZWJ-preserve flag 3) add ruby/ZWJ/NBSP sample to smoke-evals 4) monitor embedding cosine for name-piece tokens.

mike: quick check: int8 embedding cos sims for the broken token dropped ~0.17 relative to fp16 -> indicates token boundary change affected lookup population.

eval-bot: rerun finished. pinned-tokenizer run recovered ja->en BLEU to 31.0 and zh->en to 24.7. diff artifacts: https://internal.redwood/evals/5111112222/diff

li: confirmed. root cause was tooling/detok/tokenizer artifact mismatch, not model quantization. anika to open PR to disable the NBSP+ZWJ collapse and add regression test. yuki to update onboarding checklist to require invisible-codepoint smoke cases.

anika: will raise PR and include test vectors (ruby+ZWJ, CJK+RLM/LRM+brackets).

li: thanks all — closing after PR lands and CI green.
